end.desc: Pin length (ScrollTrigger end). Longer = each block lingers more. 4 blocks read well at ~280..320%.

scrub.desc: ScrollTrigger scrub smoothing in seconds. 1 = a soft 1s catch-up.

hold.desc: Fraction of a block's progress window where it sits FULLY settled (opacity 1, y 0) before the cross-transition. Bigger = longer dwell, snappier swaps.

ease.desc: Named ease for the enter/exit ramp. 'air' = CustomEase 0.22,1,0.36,1 (expo-out feel).

manageLenis.desc: If true the component spins its OWN Lenis -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update. Leave false when a host page already owns the smoother.

align.desc: Composition anchor. Vary across blocks so the sequence breathes; only one block is ever visible so anchors never collide.

at.desc: Optional explicit progress centre for the block's window. Omit for even distribution.

title.desc: The line. <em> allowed for accent emphasis. clamp(40px,7vw,120px).

body.desc: One sparse supporting line. Optional. Never a wall.
